2609.09716.title: Scaling E-Commerce Attribute Extraction with Parallel Decoding
2609.09716.paper_summary: Customers rely on specific product attributes to compare products and make purchasing decisions, but e-commerce catalogs are messy and unstructured, making it difficult to identify which attributes matter most and extract them at scale. Standard Attribute Value Extraction (AVE) systems treat all attributes equally, producing large, inconsistent attribute sets that do not reflect the factors consumers use to differentiate products. We introduce a two-stage LLM pipeline that first discovers a compact, ranked schema of purchase-discriminative attributes for each product category, then extracts their values from catalog text using a fine-tuned compact LLM (Qwen3-4B) with Hyper-Parallel Decoding (HPD). This pipeline achieves 85% extraction accuracy, on par with the foundational LLM it was distilled from, while reducing inference costs by 92% over foundational LLMs, enabling production-scale use for product discovery and catalog enrichment. The resulting category-level structured representations effectively constitute automatically constructed product knowledge bases, providing consistent, comparable attributes across varied product categories that can ground downstream knowledge-intensive applications.
2609.09716.paper_summary_zh: 客戶依賴特定的產品屬性來比較產品並做出購買決策，但電子商務目錄雜亂且無結構，這使得識別哪些屬性最重要並大規模提取它們變得困難。標準屬性值提取（AVE）系統對所有屬性一視同仁，產生大型、不一致的屬性集合，這些集合並未反映消費者用來區分產品的因素。我們提出了一個兩階段的LLM管道，首先為每個產品類別發現一個緊湊、排名的購買區分屬性架構，然後使用經過微調的緊湊LLM（Qwen3-4B）和超並行解碼（HPD）從目錄文本中提取它們的值。該管道實現了85%的提取準確率，與其提煉自的基礎LLM不相上下，同時將推理成本降低了92%，使得產品發現和目錄豐富化的生產規模使用成為可能。最終產生的類別級結構化表示有效地構成了自動構建的產品知識庫，提供了一致、可比較的屬性，跨越不同的產品類別，能夠支持下游知識密集型應用。
